iSpan Mpi Clone
===

The iSpan mpi variant by Yuede Ji, Hang Liu, and H. Howie Huang is the baseline and competitor of this project.
Unfortunately the project leaks of testing and did not ran out of the box on my system.
Further a lot of logging and time measurements is done, that is not necessary for my purposes.
I cleaned up the code and applied some minor fixes (that do not change the behaviour or characteristics to much) for my
needs, added testing and a memory aware graph converter.
